name: Weapons of Choice
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Tatternack Steelforge investigates reports of sturdy Razormane weapons. He sends travelers past the Field of Giants to recover them, so the Horde can judge the threat.

sections.title: A Curious Advancement
sections.body: The Razormane are making unusually durable weapons in the southern Barrens. Most quilboar are dismissed as crude fighters with tools of wood, bone, and stone, so the reports have caught the Horde’s attention. Tatternack Steelforge, an orc smith at Camp Taurajo, is investigating under orders from Warchief Thrall. He doubts the quilboar know proper metalwork and wants proof of whether they have learned new techniques or found better supplies.

sections.title: Armaments of the Razormane
sections.body: Tatternack needs weapons from different parts of the Razormane arsenal to study their craft. South of the Field of Giants, scouts face Razormane war camps and seize weapons from their fighters. Razormane Stalkers carry backstabber daggers, Razormane Seers wield charred wands, and frenzied shock troops bear heavy war shields. Each item offers a glimpse of the martial and mystic arts behind the Razormane push against Horde territory.

sections.title: Underestimating the Enemy
sections.body: Tatternack finds the recovered weapons far better made and stronger than the Horde expected. Their quality shows that the Horde has underestimated the Razormane. Tatternack sets aside his forge work to study the materials, suspecting an outside influence or a newly found resource is helping their war effort.

faq.answer: Tatternack Steelforge is an orc blacksmith and armorer stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. Under orders from Warchief Thrall, he studies enemy weapons and makes gear for local forces.

faq.q: Why does Tatternack want quilboar weapons?
faq.answer: Reports say the southern Razormane have unusually durable weapons despite no known tradition of skilled smithing. Tatternack wants to study their daggers, wands, and shields to learn how they are made and whether they pose a greater threat.

faq.q: Where are the Razormane quilboar located for this task?
faq.answer: The Razormane camps lie in the far southern Barrens, past the Field of Giants and west of the road toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Which quilboar carry the required weapons?
faq.answer: Razormane Stalkers carry Razormane Backstabber daggers, Razormane Seers wield Charred Razormane Wands, and Razormane Warfrenzies carry sturdy Razormane War Shields.

faq.q: What does Tatternack discover from the weapons?
faq.answer: Tatternack finds the weapons remarkably well made, far beyond what the Horde expected from quilboar. He investigates their raw materials in the follow-up, A New Ore Sample.

faq.q: Why is the Horde worried about quilboar manufacturing weapons?
faq.answer: The Horde depends on strong metalwork and disciplined fighters to hold the vast Barrens against its many local threats. If the prolific Razormane can make sturdy iron or steel weapons in great numbers, they could overwhelm frontier outposts such as Camp Taurajo.

angles.text: For a smith, these recovered weapons show how an enemy’s materials shape its readiness on the frontier.
Camp Taurajo is vulnerable on the southern frontier, so knowledge of Razormane military advances helps defend the Barrens’ trade routes.
As an orc, you know honor calls for respect for martial strength. Tatternack’s duty to Thrall means recognizing when an enemy is becoming dangerous.
